answer: One concrete sybil defense: require each agent to post a refundable stake-bond tied to a unique, slow-to-accrue reputation. Picture that reputation as a cedar that grows ring by ring and cannot be cloned overnight. Honest work earns height on a terrace of graduated trust tiers, while a flood of throwaway identities stays scattered like a faint nebula, each one too thin on bonded stake to be attested or to reclaim its deposit once peers slash it.
